controls.title: Information security program and governance
controls.description: A documented information protection program, owned by a named executive, sets the scope, objectives, roles and resources for protecting the organization's information.
controls.guidance: Look for a program charter or policy approved by management, a named security leader with defined authority, a governance forum that meets on a set schedule, and a budget or resource plan.
objectives: A documented information protection program is approved by management and defines its scope.
A named individual is accountable for the program with defined authority.
Program performance is reported to senior management at planned intervals.

controls.title: Policies and procedures
controls.description: Security policies and supporting procedures cover each control area, are approved, communicated, and reviewed at least annually.
controls.guidance: Review the policy set for coverage, approval, version history and review dates, and check that each policy is backed by operational procedures that staff actually follow.
objectives: Policies cover each control area in scope and are approved.
Procedures describe how each policy is carried out.
Policies and procedures are reviewed at least annually and after significant change.

controls.title: Scope, inheritance and shared responsibility
controls.description: The assessment scope (organizational units, systems, facilities and data) is defined, and controls inherited from or shared with service providers are identified with their responsibility split.
controls.guidance: Review the scoping worksheet and system inventory, and the control responsibility matrix showing which controls are performed by the organization, by a service provider, or shared.
objectives: The scope of the assessment is documented, including systems, facilities and data types.
Controls inherited from or shared with service providers are identified with the responsible party for each.
Evidence of inherited controls (for example the provider's own assessment or report) is obtained.

controls.title: Compliance with legal and contractual requirements
controls.description: Applicable legal, regulatory and contractual security and privacy requirements are identified and their compliance is checked.
controls.guidance: Look for a register of applicable requirements (for example HIPAA, state laws, contracts) and periodic compliance reviews or internal audits.
objectives: Applicable legal, regulatory and contractual requirements are documented.
Compliance with security policies and requirements is reviewed through internal audit or management review.

controls.title: Malware protection
controls.description: Endpoints and servers run malware protection that is centrally managed, kept up to date and cannot be disabled by users.
controls.guidance: Check the endpoint protection console for coverage against the asset inventory, signature or engine currency, alert handling and tamper protection.
objectives: Malware protection is installed on all in-scope endpoints and servers.
Protection is kept current and centrally monitored, and alerts are handled.
Users cannot disable or uninstall the protection.

controls.title: Endpoint hardening and host firewall
controls.description: Endpoints are built to a secure baseline with a host firewall enabled and unnecessary services removed.
controls.guidance: Sample endpoints against the documented baseline: host firewall, disabled services, local administrator restrictions and disk encryption for laptops.
objectives: Endpoints are configured to a documented secure baseline.
Host firewalls are enabled and centrally managed.
Laptops holding sensitive data use full-disk encryption.

controls.title: Removable media controls
controls.description: Use of removable media is restricted, sensitive data on removable media is encrypted, and media is sanitized before disposal or reuse.
controls.guidance: Review the media policy, device control settings that block or restrict USB storage, encryption of approved media and sanitization records.
objectives: Use of removable media is restricted to approved, business-justified cases.
Sensitive data written to removable media is encrypted.
Media is sanitized or destroyed before disposal or reuse, and this is recorded.

controls.title: Mobile device management
controls.description: Mobile devices that access organizational data are enrolled in device management, which enforces screen lock, encryption and remote wipe.
controls.guidance: Check the MDM console for enrolment coverage, enforced settings, jailbreak or root detection and remote wipe capability, and the bring-your-own-device policy.
objectives: Mobile devices accessing organizational data are enrolled in device management.
Screen lock, encryption and remote wipe are enforced.
Lost or stolen devices are reported and wiped.

controls.title: Wireless network protection
controls.description: Wireless networks use strong encryption and authentication, guest wireless is separated from internal networks, and rogue access points are detected.
controls.guidance: Review wireless configuration (WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise), segmentation of guest networks and records of rogue access point scans.
objectives: Corporate wireless networks use strong encryption and individual authentication.
Guest wireless is segregated from internal networks.
Scans for rogue access points are performed at defined intervals.

controls.title: Secure baselines
controls.description: Secure configuration baselines exist for each system type and systems are checked for deviation.
controls.guidance: Review baselines (for example derived from CIS benchmarks), configuration scanning results and handling of deviations.
objectives: Documented secure baselines exist for operating systems, network devices, databases and cloud services in scope.
Systems are checked against baselines and deviations are remediated or approved.

controls.title: Change control
controls.description: Changes to systems are requested, risk-assessed, tested, approved and recorded, with emergency changes reviewed afterwards.
controls.guidance: Sample changes from the change log for request, testing, approval, segregation between developer and approver, and post-implementation review.
objectives: Changes are documented, tested and approved before implementation.
Emergency changes are reviewed and approved after the fact.
Development, test and production environments are separated.

controls.title: Asset inventory
controls.description: An inventory of hardware, software and information assets in scope is maintained, with owners assigned.
controls.guidance: Compare the inventory with discovery tools and sample assets for owner, classification and location.
objectives: Hardware and software inventories are complete and current.
Each asset has an assigned owner.

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning and patching
controls.description: Systems are scanned for vulnerabilities at defined intervals, and patches are applied within timeframes set by severity.
controls.guidance: Review scan schedules and coverage, remediation timeframes by severity, and evidence that critical and high findings are fixed on time or formally accepted.
objectives: Internal and external vulnerability scans are run at defined intervals across in-scope systems.
Patches are applied within documented timeframes by severity.
Exceptions are risk-accepted and tracked.

controls.title: Penetration testing
controls.description: Penetration tests of in-scope systems are performed at least annually and after significant change, and findings are remediated.
controls.guidance: Review the latest test reports, tester independence, scope and remediation tracking.
objectives: Penetration tests are performed at least annually by qualified, independent testers.
Findings are tracked to remediation and retested.

controls.title: Network segmentation and boundary protection
controls.description: Networks are segmented by function and sensitivity, and boundary devices restrict traffic to what is needed.
controls.guidance: Review network diagrams, firewall rule sets and rule review records, and segmentation of systems holding sensitive data.
objectives: Network diagrams are current and show segmentation and data flows.
Firewall rules restrict traffic to approved services and are reviewed at least every six months.
Systems holding sensitive data are segregated from general networks.

controls.title: Remote access
controls.description: Remote access to internal networks uses encrypted connections and multi-factor authentication and is logged.
controls.guidance: Check VPN or zero trust access configuration, MFA enforcement, session timeouts and logging.
objectives: Remote access uses encrypted channels and multi-factor authentication.
Remote sessions are logged and time out after inactivity.

controls.title: Encryption in transit
controls.description: Sensitive data sent over public or untrusted networks is encrypted using current protocols, including email and file transfer.
controls.guidance: Check TLS configuration of external services, secure email and file transfer methods, and disabled weak protocols and ciphers.
objectives: Sensitive data transmitted over public networks is encrypted with current protocols.
Weak protocols and ciphers are disabled.
Secure methods are used for email and file transfer of sensitive data.

controls.title: Password and authenticator management
controls.description: Passwords meet length and complexity requirements, are stored securely, and are changed when compromise is suspected, and default credentials are changed.
controls.guidance: Review password policy settings in the directory and key applications, storage of credentials, password manager use and handling of default and shared accounts.
objectives: Password policy settings enforce documented length and complexity requirements.
Default passwords are changed before systems go into use.
Passwords are stored and transmitted only in protected form.

controls.title: User provisioning and deprovisioning
controls.description: User access is requested, approved and granted on least privilege, and removed promptly when people leave or change roles.
controls.guidance: Sample joiners, movers and leavers for approval records and timely removal, comparing HR records with directory accounts.
objectives: Access is approved before it is granted and follows least privilege.
Access is removed within a defined period of termination or role change.

controls.title: Access reviews
controls.description: User and privileged access is reviewed at defined intervals by owners, and inappropriate access is removed.
controls.guidance: Review evidence of completed access reviews for in-scope systems and the removals that resulted.
objectives: User access to in-scope systems is reviewed at least annually, and privileged access more often.
Inappropriate access found in reviews is removed and recorded.

controls.title: Privileged access and multi-factor authentication
controls.description: Privileged accounts are restricted, separate from day-to-day accounts and protected by multi-factor authentication.
controls.guidance: Check the list of privileged accounts, use of separate admin accounts, MFA on privileged and remote access, and segregation of duties.
objectives: Privileged access is limited to named people with a business need.
Privileged and remote access requires multi-factor authentication.
Incompatible duties are segregated.

controls.title: Audit logging
controls.description: Security-relevant events are logged on in-scope systems, logs are protected from change and retained for a defined period.
controls.guidance: Check log sources against the inventory, logged event types (logons, privileged actions, changes to sensitive data), log integrity protection and retention.
objectives: Security-relevant events are logged on in-scope systems.
Logs are protected from unauthorized change and retained for a defined period.
System clocks are synchronized.

controls.title: Monitoring and alerting
controls.description: Logs are collected centrally and reviewed or monitored for suspicious activity, with alerts investigated.
controls.guidance: Review the SIEM or log management setup, alert rules, review frequency and evidence of alert investigation.
objectives: Logs are aggregated centrally and monitored for suspicious activity.
Alerts are investigated and escalated as incidents where warranted.

controls.title: Security and privacy training
controls.description: Workforce members receive security and privacy training at onboarding and at least annually, with role-based training for those with security duties.
controls.guidance: Review training content, completion records, phishing exercises and role-based training for administrators and developers.
objectives: Security and privacy awareness training is completed at onboarding and annually.
Role-based training is provided to people with security responsibilities.
Completion is tracked and followed up.

controls.title: Third-party risk assessment
controls.description: Third parties that access, process or host the organization's sensitive information are identified, risk-assessed before engagement and reassessed periodically.
controls.guidance: Review the third-party inventory, risk tiering, due diligence questionnaires or assurance reports obtained, and reassessment schedule.
objectives: An inventory of third parties with access to sensitive information is maintained.
Third parties are risk-assessed before engagement and periodically after.
Assurance evidence (for example certifications or audit reports) is obtained and reviewed.

controls.title: Third-party agreements
controls.description: Agreements with third parties set security and privacy requirements, breach notification, right to audit and return or destruction of data.
controls.guidance: Sample contracts and business associate agreements for required security clauses.
objectives: Contracts with third parties include security, privacy and breach notification requirements.
Business associate agreements are in place where required.

controls.title: Incident response plan
controls.description: A documented incident response plan defines roles, severity levels, escalation, containment, notification and recovery, and is tested at least annually.
controls.guidance: Review the plan, the incident response team and contacts, breach notification procedures and evidence of tabletop or other tests.
objectives: A documented incident response plan defines roles, severity levels and escalation.
The plan covers breach notification to individuals, regulators and partners as required.
The plan is tested at least annually and updated from lessons learned.

controls.title: Incident handling and reporting
controls.description: Workforce members know how to report incidents, and incidents are recorded, investigated, contained and reviewed.
controls.guidance: Review the incident register and a sample of incidents for timely response, root cause and lessons learned.
objectives: Workforce members are told how to report suspected incidents.
Incidents are recorded with their handling, root cause and lessons learned.

controls.title: Continuity and recovery planning
controls.description: Business impact analysis sets recovery priorities, and business continuity and disaster recovery plans are documented and tested.
controls.guidance: Review the BIA, recovery time and point objectives, the plans and test results.
objectives: A business impact analysis sets recovery time and point objectives for critical systems.
Business continuity and disaster recovery plans are documented and tested at least annually.

controls.title: Backup
controls.description: Backups of critical data and systems are performed, protected, stored separately and tested for restoration.
controls.guidance: Check backup schedules and success monitoring, encryption and offsite or immutable copies, and restore test records.
objectives: Backups of critical data run on a defined schedule and failures are followed up.
Backups are encrypted and a copy is stored separately from production.
Restores are tested at defined intervals.

controls.title: Risk assessment
controls.description: A formal risk assessment of in-scope systems and information is performed at least annually and after significant change, using a defined method.
controls.guidance: Review the risk methodology, the most recent assessment and how threats and vulnerabilities to sensitive data were evaluated.
objectives: A documented risk assessment method defines likelihood, impact and acceptance criteria.
Risk assessments are performed at least annually and after significant change.

controls.title: Risk treatment and corrective action plans
controls.description: Risks are treated, accepted or transferred by authorized people, and gaps are tracked in corrective action plans to closure.
controls.guidance: Review the risk register, acceptance approvals and corrective action plans with owners, dates and status.
objectives: Risks have a treatment decision approved by an authorized owner.
Corrective action plans record owner, target date and status for each gap and are tracked to closure.

controls.title: Physical access
controls.description: Physical access to facilities and areas holding sensitive systems or information is restricted, logged and reviewed, and visitors are escorted.
controls.guidance: Inspect access controls for data centres and secure areas, badge access reviews and visitor logs. For cloud-hosted systems, rely on the provider's assurance evidence.
objectives: Access to secure areas is restricted to authorized people and reviewed.
Visitors are logged and escorted.

controls.title: Environmental protection and equipment
controls.description: Facilities housing systems are protected against fire, water, power and temperature risks, and equipment is maintained and disposed of securely.
controls.guidance: Check fire suppression, power protection, environmental monitoring, maintenance records and secure disposal records.
objectives: Environmental protections are in place and maintained for facilities housing in-scope systems.
Equipment is disposed of or reused only after data is securely removed.

controls.title: Data classification and handling
controls.description: Information is classified by sensitivity and handled, labelled, retained and disposed of according to its classification.
controls.guidance: Review the classification scheme, handling rules, data inventory or flow maps for sensitive data, and retention schedule.
objectives: A classification scheme with handling rules is documented and communicated.
Locations and flows of sensitive data are documented.
Data is retained and disposed of according to a retention schedule.

controls.title: Encryption at rest and data loss prevention
controls.description: Sensitive data at rest is encrypted where risk requires, keys are managed, and controls detect or prevent unauthorized data transfer.
controls.guidance: Check encryption of databases, storage and backups, key management procedures and DLP coverage for email, web and endpoints.
objectives: Sensitive data at rest is encrypted where required, with keys managed securely.
Controls detect or prevent unauthorized transfer of sensitive data.

controls.title: Privacy practices
controls.description: Personal and health information is collected, used and disclosed only as permitted, individuals are given notice, and their rights requests are handled.
controls.guidance: Review the notice of privacy practices, minimum necessary rules, handling of individual rights requests and accounting of disclosures where required.
objectives: Notice of privacy practices is provided to individuals as required.
Use and disclosure of personal information is limited to permitted purposes and the minimum necessary.
Individual rights requests are handled within required timeframes.
